exposure: type of incisional hernia repair (open anatomical, open mesh onlay, open mesh underlay, combined onlay/underlay, laparoscopic mesh onlay)
outcome: post-operative complications (wound infection, seroma, wound dehiscence)
cohort: The study included 50 patients who underwent surgical intervention for incisional hernias.
finding: The majority of incisional hernia cases can be managed electively with various anatomical and mesh repairs, resulting in a relatively low incidence of post-operative complications with proper surgical techniques and care.
mod_finding: Incisional hernias were often associated with previous abdominal surgeries, particularly caesarean sections.
